DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

[Docket No. EL26-112-000]


Moraga Storage, LLC, River Mill Storage, LLC, Hecate Energy 
Medway Energy Center LLC, Brough Storage, LLC, Partridge Storage, LLC 
v. ISO New England Inc.; Notice on Comment Periods

    On September 30, 2026, Moraga Storage, LLC; River Mill Storage, 
LLC; Hecate Energy Medway Energy Center LLC; Brough Storage, LLC; and 
Partridge Storage, LLC (collectively, Project Companies) filed a 
complaint and waiver request in the above-referenced docket. Project 
Companies request a shortened 10-day comment period because they must 
decide whether to execute a Large Generator Interconnection Agreement 
(LGIA), seek to file an unexecuted LGIA, or withdraw from the ISO New 
England Inc. (ISO-NE) interconnection queue by October 20, 2026.
    On October 1, 2026, ISO-NE filed a motion in opposition to a 
shortened comment period, requesting the full 30-day comment period to 
respond to the complaint. On October 2, 2026, Project Companies filed 
an answer requesting a 10-day comment period for the waiver request and 
a 20-day answer period for the complaint.
    Upon consideration, notice is hereby given that Project Companies' 
request for shortened comment period is partially granted. The deadline 
for filing comments pertaining to the waiver request is hereby 
shortened to 5:00 p.m. EDT on Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
    The deadline for filing ISO-NE's answer or comments pertaining to 
the complaint is 5:00 p.m. EDT on Friday, October 30, 2026.

    Dated: October 5, 2026.
Debbie-Anne A. Reese,
Secretary.
[FR Doc. 2026-21364 Filed 10-16-26; 8:45 am]
BILLING CODE 6717-01-P
